{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Remove commas from revenue column to handle thousands separators
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)

# Now safely cast to float
sales['revenue_float'] = sales['revenue_clean'].astype(float)

# Confirm the test orders are now correctly identified
internal_test_orders = (sales['revenue_float'] == 999999.99)
print("Number of internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99):", internal_test_orders.sum())

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = (sales['status'] == 'refunded')
print("Number of refunded orders:", refunded_orders.sum())

# Filter for completed orders and exclude internal test orders
completed_orders = (sales['status'] == 'completed')
valid_orders = completed_orders & ~internal_test_orders

# Compute total revenue from valid completed orders
total_revenue = sales.loc[valid_orders, 'revenue_float'].sum()
print("Total revenue from completed orders (excluding test orders):", total_revenue)"}
